## How skgen answers

As a content author, or a script or agent that runs skgen for me,
I want the exit code and the two streams to say what happened,
so that a run can tell "the text failed hygiene" from "the command was wrong".

Exit 0 is success, 2 a prose candidate that failed the manifest's hygiene
gate, 1 anything else: a mistake in the command, a refused paid call or a
provider failure. Answers are JSON on stdout; errors go to stderr.

**Rule: A mistake in the command exits 1, says what was wrong, and writes nothing.**

  ```console
         skgen prose ingest <manifest> --only <id> --text-file <path> --author <text> [--provider <name>]
  ```

## Generate catalog prose from a manifest

As a content author with a prose manifest (one entry per catalog card),
I want skgen to plan for free, spend money only when I confirm, and score
every candidate against the facts the card must and must not carry,
so that a run never costs by accident and bad text never passes quietly.

`--provider fake` answers every entry with one fixed Barbarian paragraph
("Primary Ability: Strength. Hit Point Die: D12 per Barbarian level. …
Greataxe."), so these scenarios run offline and the reply is known.

## Write catalog prose without a provider credential

As a coding agent with no model credential,
I want the exact prompt a paid run would send, and a way to hand my own
text back into the same run.json under the same hygiene gate,
so that I can write the prose myself and the record says honestly who wrote it.

These verbs make no provider call: the scenarios run with no credential
in the environment.

### ingest records my text as an agent-session candidate, never as a model's

Status: **verified** · Code: [`ingestProse`](../src/text/run.ts)

> The cell names who wrote it and hashes the exact prompt it answers, so a later template change shows as drift; it claims no model, because no model call happened.

  ```console
        "usage": {},
        "hygiene": {
          "pass": true,
          "missing": [],
          "leaked": []

        "provider": "agent-session",

        "prompt_hash": "sha256:f09efd69c6c1fb6a8b28c966502824d912b48e4cfe4541d94383c0342427e76b"
      }
    ]
  }
  [exit 0]
  ```

## Plan catalog images before paying for them

As a content author with an art manifest or a provider blueprint,
I want every plan to name the provider route and the expected usage
without a credential or a provider call,
so that I know what a confirmed run will cost before I confirm it.

The scenarios run with no PIXELLAB_SECRET and no OPENAI_API_KEY: a plan
that reached for a provider would fail, not spend.

  ```console
  [exit 0]
  ```
